result: Actual-source collisions survive joint observables through dimension 21; a certified local 22-feature map is injective, yet bounded feature measurement error restores ambiguity in the same neighborhood.
source_premises: Inherited complete discriminant-576 two-field metadata class and complete 22-entry positive source prefixes below 39/2. Source selection precedes coordinate errors; every entry and multiplicity remains.
joint_features: Seventeen original finite Gaussians, then the finite rational moment, center 37, changed-width center 2, center 41 and center 43. No raw roots, counts or unknown tails are implicitly included.
existence_proof: Twelve rational correction boxes are strict self-mapping contractions by real interval Jacobians and independent complex Taylor bounds. Modular preconditioner nonsingularity and exact source inclusions make the exact feature equalities feasible for both actual fields.
local_result: The selected 22-feature map is injective on the closed infinity-norm box of radius 1e-10 about the rational midpoint list. All epsilon=1e-18 collisions are inside it; the 21-feature witness is distinguished by the final feature.
measurement_noise: At tau=5e-18, use the exact first 21 B features and the last B feature minus 4.5e-18. Both actual fields realize this noisy 22-feature release inside the local neighborhood. Root-coordinate and feature-measurement errors are distinct stages.
formal_scope: Six new Lean lemmas check the local defect-to-injectivity/stability logic and scope controls. The vector mean-value/row-norm, interval, modular matrix, field and spectral bridges remain written/computational.
open_gates: Global injectivity over admissible observation sets, sharp root/feature noise tradeoffs, validated parameter families, stronger neighborhoods and conditioning, physical precision and acquisition contracts, and broader ACS branches remain open.
